mapper.select: SELECT id, name, code, biz_type, dept_id, status, description, create_time, update_time FROM approval_flow WHERE status = 1 AND (biz_type = #{bizType} OR biz_type IS NULL) AND (dept_id = #{deptId} OR dept_id IS NULL) ORDER BY (biz_type IS NOT NULL) DESC, (dept_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, name, code, biz_type, dept_id, status, description, create_time, update_time FROM approval_flow
AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY id DESC
